name: Long March 3B
manufacturer: CALT (China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology)
best_known_for: China's GTO workhorse — Chang'e 3 / 4 lunar landers + most commercial comsats from Xichang
credit: Fleet launcher entry backfilled to wire CZ-3B up through /plan's view-in-fleet link. First flight (1996-02-15, Intelsat 708) was a guidance-loop failure that killed villagers downrange and forced a years-long redesign — Long March 3B has since flown well over 100 successful missions and is the primary launcher for Chang'e lunar exploration.
